title: Preserve lesson context from calendar navigation

evidence: The original task requires optional studentAccountId context and its claim-specific RED proves that the current calendar output cannot provide a server-authorized student identity without changing the task-forbidden loader.
The operator accepted shared-only AC-008 through /feature-to-tasks FT-003; fresh TASK-039-T3-FT-003-W10 is the reviewed replacement for exact date/class/lesson navigation with no studentAccountId.
TASK-038 is not closure-eligible and its RED is not reused as TASK-039 proof. No production code, unsafe side effect, retry, or verification gate was replayed.

evidence_required: FT-003-AC-008 / REQ-005 / REQ-006 / REQ-014 RED: a rendered calendar lesson link loses date/class/lesson/optional-student context, points outside the existing `/lesson-context` route, or permits guessed student context; GREEN: a fresh real route/SSR probe follows a DB-backed calendar lesson link, preserves the exact query identity, observes the existing Lesson Context response recheck, and proves denied student context renders no private data and leaves state unchanged; artifact: `.tasks/TASK-038-T3-FT-003-W10/` and `.protocols/TASK-038-T3-FT-003-W10/verification.md`.
purpose: Make each authorized calendar lesson navigate to the existing Lesson Context route without losing or widening actor/class/student context.
success_outcome: A lesson rendered by the authorized calendar exposes a link to `/lesson-context` carrying the exact date, classId, lessonId, and only an optional server-permitted studentAccountId; the existing route rechecks authorization and rejects guessed student context without private data or mutation.
anti_goals: Do not replace the public home fixture or change the `/calendar` server load and DB-backed lesson ownership established by TASK-037.
Do not modify the existing `/lesson-context` route/module, add a second day-context API, or move composition/authorization ownership out of Lesson Context.
Do not trust a client-selected role, center, class, lesson, or student account and do not write scheduling, lesson, progress, collaboration, or financial state.

stop_conditions: Stop if preserving context requires changing the existing Lesson Context route/module, adding a new API or persistence boundary, or bypassing its server-side authorization; route to /spec-redesign only for an accepted shared-boundary change.
Stop if studentAccountId cannot be limited to the server-returned authorized scope or if a guessed/mismatched student context cannot be shown denied with state equality.
Stop if the calendar link cannot be proved independently from TASK-037's protected-load matrix; do not inherit its proof as navigation evidence.

constraints: The component consumes the server-rendered lesson identity and the server-authorized class/student scope from TASK-037; it does not resolve authorization or read persistence itself.

Lesson links use the existing `/lesson-context` query contract (`date`, `classId`, `lessonId`, optional `studentAccountId`) and the existing route remains responsible for final composition and authorization.
The navigation probe must follow a real rendered link and independently compare authorized and guessed-student responses; TASK-037's DB calendar proof is a dependency, not inherited AC-008 evidence.
invariants: Calendar-to-Lesson-Context navigation preserves exact date/class/lesson identity and only carries a studentAccountId permitted by the server-resolved scope.
Guessed or mismatched student context renders no private data and leaves persisted state unchanged because the existing Lesson Context route rechecks authorization.
The public `/` fixture, TASK-037 protected-load boundary, existing Lesson Context owner, downstream feature ownership, and all completed prerequisite tasks remain unchanged.
verification_targets: FT-003-AC-008 / REQ-005 / REQ-006 / REQ-014: follow one real rendered lesson link with and without permitted studentAccountId, assert exact `/lesson-context` query preservation and existing DayContext navigation identity, then attempt a guessed student context and assert denial-body minimization plus state equality.

Boundary regression: source review confirms only the calendar presentation/link surface and its isolated navigation test changed, the link targets the existing `/lesson-context` path, no client role/student trust or direct persistence exists, and project-native check/test/build/diff gates pass.
